name: Translate texts between specified language pairs
description: Users requested the translation of various texts, predominantly from English to Arabic, but also including pairs such as Arabic to French, Persian to Arabic, and Arabic to English or other European languages. The content spanned a wide range of topics including medical cases, business documents, legal matters, historical narratives, and personal communications, with users occasionally specifying requirements for tone, dialect, or accuracy.
